label: Lennard-Jones (element-specific)
elements: Li, Be, B, C, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S
notes: Analytic reference, not a trained model: Lennard-Jones with per-element sigma (minimum at 2 * covalent_radius) and epsilon (cohesive energy / 8.61, the LJ fcc lattice sum), force-smoothed between 0.66 rc and rc = 3 sigma.  Exactly conservative and E(3)-invariant by construction, so its scores are the suite's own numerical floor.
